etymologies.etymologyHTML: From Middle English mys-understanden, equivalent to mis- +‎ understand.

definitions.definition: (transitive) To understand incorrectly, while believing one has understood correctly.

quote.citation: 2024, NTSB, Intersection Crash Between Passenger Car and Combination Vehicle, Tishomingo, Oklahoma, March 22, 2022:
quote.text: We found that teen drivers and the public largely misunderstand the legal status of cannabis use and do not fully recognize the risks of cannabis-impaired driving.
